state.objective: Recommend circuit breaker trip threshold for partner billing service.

context.content: Current traffic: 300 req/sec; current failure rate 2.1% under normal loads.
DNS resolution time: 2ms via local Unbound cache.

submitted_answer.answer: Set the circuit breaker latency-trip threshold to 1000 ms; the 2 ms DNS resolution time does not justify a similarly tiny request timeout.
